_: Architect's review of the enrich-v1 run over the five proofread store collections.
Committed as DATA, not applied as a one-off SQL script, because the database is rebuilt
(migrate:fresh) before the app cuts over to backend2 — a review that lives only in a
terminal history would be lost exactly once and nobody would notice.
Rows are matched by TEXT, not by id: ids are regenerated on every rebuild, the text is the
decision. `apply` reports anything it could not match instead of failing silently.

_acknowledge: Findings the architect looked at and decided to keep as-is. Acknowledging them takes them out
of the worklist without deleting the record of what the run saw (the findings table is
append-only). Everything NOT listed here that the run flagged is also acknowledged — the
review says «всё прочее, не названное выше — тоже флаг-ок» — so `apply` acknowledges every
finding of this version that its own actions did not already resolve.
prescription/«recipe» is the interesting one: a false friend we WANT to keep punishing, because
the term being taught is prescription.
